questions.questionText: Before style sheets, which tag was used to change the color and typeface of text?
Which CSS property specifies the horizontal alignment of text?
Which property specifies the decoration of text such as underline?
Which property specifies indentation of the first line of text?
Which property changes the casing of text?
Which property increases or decreases space between words?
Which property specifies the font or a generic family for text?
Which property specifies the size of the font?
Which property sets whether the font is normal, italic, or oblique?
Which property specifies whether text appears in small-caps?
If a browser does not support the specified font, it will:
options: Display the default font of the browser
questions.correctAnswer: Display the default font of the browser
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Display the default font of the browser.

questions.questionText: Which text-align value justifies text on both sides?
Which text-align value places text in the middle?
The default value of text-indent is:
text-indent: 2em indents the first line with respect to:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Font size.

questions.questionText: Which text-transform value makes the first letter of each word uppercase?
text-transform: uppercase displays:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Only capital letters.

questions.questionText: text-decoration: line-through displays:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) A line through the text.

questions.questionText: text-decoration: overline displays:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) A line over the text.

questions.questionText: text-decoration: none displays:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Normal text without decoration.

questions.questionText: Which value of word-spacing denotes normal spacing?
word-spacing: 2px sets:
options: A fixed space of 2 pixels between words
questions.correctAnswer: A fixed space of 2 pixels between words
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) A fixed space of 2 pixels between words.

questions.questionText: The <span> tag is used to:
options: Group inline elements in a document
questions.correctAnswer: Group inline elements in a document
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Group inline elements in a document.

questions.questionText: The <span> tag is useful when you want to:
options: Style part of a sentence without using <b>
questions.correctAnswer: Style part of a sentence without using <b>
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Style part of a sentence without using <b>.

questions.questionText: Which attribute of <span> specifies a unique identifier?
Which attribute specifies extra information about an element?
Indenting is the process of:
options: Setting off text from its normal position to left or right
questions.correctAnswer: Setting off text from its normal position to left or right
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Setting off text from its normal position to left or right.

questions.questionText: Which property adds space between the border of an element and its contents?
Which property adds whitespace around an element (outside its border)?
Borders in CSS are:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Rectangular outlines surrounding an element.

questions.questionText: Which CSS border properties are used?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Style, color, and width.

questions.questionText: Which property sets the style of all four borders?
Which value of border-style gives a dotted line?
Which of the following is a valid border-style value?
Which border-style value draws a 3D grooved border?
Which border-style makes the border appear as a 3D inset?
The border-color property applies colors to:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) All four borders.

questions.questionText: Which property sets only the top border's color?
The border-color value "transparent" means:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) The border is transparent.

questions.questionText: Which can be used to specify border colors?
options: RGB, hexadecimal values, or color names
questions.correctAnswer: RGB, hexadecimal values, or color names
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) RGB, hexadecimal values, or color names.

questions.questionText: border-color: red blue green yellow displays:
options: Top red, right blue, bottom green, left yellow
questions.correctAnswer: Top red, right blue, bottom green, left yellow
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Top red, right blue, bottom green, left yellow.

questions.questionText: The border-width property specifies:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) The thickness of borders.

questions.questionText: Which property sets the width of only the bottom border?
Which border-width value can be an explicit length?
Which of the following is a predefined border-width value?
The shorthand property border sets:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Width, style, and color together.

questions.questionText: Which is the correct shorthand for a 2px solid red border?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) border: 2px solid red;.

questions.questionText: The margin property is used to add:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Whitespace around an element.

questions.questionText: Which property adds space inside the border around the content?
Which of the following describes the effect of word-spacing?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Changes the space between words.
